users.title: Users
users.description: Logins for CEAT staff and client employees. Users are never deleted — deactivate them instead.
users.deactivateDescription: They will be logged out, won't be able to log in and won't receive emails. The account and everything it did stay in the system; it can be restored at any time.
users.actionFailed: Could not change the user's status

audit.title: Action log
audit.description: Who changed, attached or deleted what — newest first.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the action log

container.dates_reset: ETD/ETA reset to the file's dates

login.failed: Could not log in, please try again

piList.title: Proforma Invoices
piList.emptyWithArchived: No cards — enable “Show archived” to see them.

uploadPi.title: Upload proforma
uploadPi.description: The PI number is recognized from the file name. If a card with this number already exists and has no file yet, the file will be attached to it; otherwise a new card is created.

files.title: Files
files.notUploadedByCeat: The proforma has not been uploaded by CEAT yet.
files.replaceSignedHint: The current signed file will stay available in the file history.
files.notSignedYet: The client has not uploaded the signed file yet.

history.title: File history
history.loadFailed: Could not load the file history

lines.title: Line items
lines.confirmReset: Reset all priority for this proforma?

readyToShip.title: Ready to ship
readyToShip.descriptionClient: Distribute the weekly plan across containers, confirm it and attach the marking.
readyToShip.descriptionOps: The client's plan (view only). A confirmed container can be unlocked.

actions.title: Unsaved changes
actions.blockedNothing: Nothing to confirm: no containers with items
actions.undoAllDescription: All moves in unconfirmed containers will be rolled back and the items will return to the ready list. Confirmed containers are not affected. This cannot be undone in the current session.
actions.confirmDescription: All containers with items will be confirmed ({{n}}). After that the contents can only be changed once CEAT unlocks the container, and a marking file must be uploaded for every item.

list.title: Ready list
list.searchPlaceholder: Search: material, description, PI, name, SO
list.allDistributed: Everything is allocated — nothing is left in the ready list.
list.notPlaceableHint: Cannot be placed: the line has no loadability, so its container fill cannot be calculated

containers.title: Containers
containers.emptyClient: Nothing placed yet: use “Move” in the list on the left.

card.overfilledWarning: Filled over 100% — the plan cannot be confirmed until the container is unloaded.
card.shareHint: Share of the container taken by this line

marking.validUntilChanged: The file stays valid until the quantity in this line changes
marking.deleteDescription: {{material}} in “{{container}}”: the file will be deleted and will need to be uploaded again.

move.title: Move to container
move.allConfirmed: All containers are confirmed — there is nowhere to move to. Ask CEAT to unlock one.
move.overloadWarning: “{{label}}” will be filled to {{percent}}: you can move it, but you will not be able to confirm the plan while the container is overloaded.

remove.title: Remove from “{{container}}”
remove.info: PI {{title}} · currently in the container: {{qty}} pcs. What you remove goes back to the ready list.

errors.max: No more than is in the container ({{max}})

unlock.title: Unlock “{{label}}”?
unlock.description: After unlocking, the client will be able to change the contents of this container; marking files on changed lines will be deleted.

unlockLine.title: Unlock {{material}} in “{{container}}”?
unlockLine.description: After unlocking, the client will be able to change just this one line — the rest of the container stays confirmed. Its marking file will be deleted if the quantity changes.

shipped.title: Shipped
shipped.description: Shipped, based on the weekly file.
shipped.searchPlaceholder: Search: container, vessel, port, invoice, B/L
shipped.empty: There are no containers yet — they will appear after the weekly backorder file with the shipment sheets is uploaded.

arrival.revokeDescription: Use this if the client confirmed arrival by mistake. The marker goes back to “Arrival expected” — unless 7 or more days have already passed since the ETA, in which case it stays “Arrived (default)” by the automatic rule.
arrival.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the arrival confirmation

shipped.overrideHintNoSource: Date changed manually (no date in the file)

files.title: Files
files.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” will be removed from the container's file list.

lines.title: Line items
lines.noCard: There is no card with this PI number

dates.hint: A date you enter replaces the file's date and is not overwritten by the weekly upload. An empty field removes the manual date.
dates.resetDescription: The manual ETD/ETA will be removed and the dates from the backorder file will be shown again.
